I fired my best client in March.

They paid $9,000 a month. On time. Never rude.

But every call started the same way: "quick question" and ended 90 minutes later with a rewrite of the strategy we agreed on in January.

I did the math. The retainer worked out to $41 an hour.

My cheapest client pays $2,500 and takes four hours a month. That's $625 an hour.

So I sent a two-line email and felt sick for a day.

Then I slept better than I had in six months.

Revenue is a vanity metric when you don't count the hours.
